privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Information on Data Processing according to the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)

sections.heading: 1. Data Controller
sections.content:
The controller responsible for data processing on this website within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is:
Lukas Kraus
Email: krauluk1@gmail.com

sections.heading: 2. Data Subject Rights
sections.content: Under the applicable data protection laws, you have the following rights at any time with respect to the controller:
list: Right of access to your stored personal data (Art. 15 GDPR)
Right to rectification of inaccurate personal data (Art. 16 GDPR)
Right to erasure ('Right to be forgotten') (Art. 17 GDPR)
Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
Right to object to processing (Art. 21 GDPR)

sections.heading: 3. Server Log Files & Hosting
sections.content: When accessing this website, the hosting provider (GitHub Pages / GitHub Inc., 88 Colin P Kelly Jr St, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA) automatically collects and stores standard server log files transmitted by your browser. These logs include your IP address, browser type and version, operating system, referrer URL, and timestamp. This data is processed for the legitimate interest of ensuring technical security and stability (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.heading: 4. Local Storage Usage
sections.content: This website uses your browser's local storage (localStorage) exclusively to store your game exploration progress (unlocked sector dossiers, collected tech orbs, and audio preferences). No tracking cookies or third-party analytics trackers are used.

sections.heading: 5. SSL / TLS Encryption
sections.content: For security reasons and to protect data transmission across the network, this site uses end-to-end HTTPS encryption (SSL/TLS).

sections.heading: 6. Contact & Inquiries
sections.content: If you have any questions regarding privacy or data protection on this website, please contact: krauluk1@gmail.com
